additional_info.subject: ID0468505-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S6 170003771] AC Input issue CRM:03056000826
additional_info.body:
Hello Laurenz, good morning.
This is a topic that R&D is already working on. The problem here is that the new PAC meters include some new registers that were not included in the FW of the charger and the charger is false positively saying there is an error.
The solution will come by a remote update to the PAC meter.
For now, since there is nothing from our side to be done, I will close the ticket.
When we have a solution, it will be shared to all of eMobility by R&D.
If you ever need an update, feel free to reach out to me via Teams and I will provide all the information that is available.
Thank you and have a lovely holidays.
Best regards,
Francisco
